name: Weakness, Greater
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, druid 2, inquisitor 2, paladin 2, psychic 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, summoner/unchained summoner 2, witch 2
Duration 1 minute/level

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as weakness except as noted above and the resistance bonus to saves is increased to +3.
